description: Authority rules: which sources may support which claim types. Conflicts between permitted sources are first-class issues requiring human adjudication, not silent smoothing.

rules.precedence_note: The approved SAP provides the operational analysis definition; the protocol declares the endpoint. Disagreement on operational definition follows the SAP (protocol section 9.1) but must still be surfaced as an issue.

rules.note: Reported estimates come from final TLF cells only. Dataset recounts are cross-checks, not primary sources.
Narrative facts come from ADSL/ADAE records for the subject.
Interpretive characterizations (e.g. clinical meaningfulness) are never supported by sources alone; they require accountable human approval and are flagged unless pre-approved language exists.
